patches: Import the serialized passive XHTML document tree into the iframe without document.write or HTML reparsing. Admission, section search, CFI validation, and viewport now retain the same XML structure for every admitted element, including implicit-table-body, foster-parenting, and paragraph-normalization cases.

Replace the path-webpack 0.0.3 transitive POSIX-path shim with pinned path-browserify 1.0.1. The former declares MIT but supplies no license text. The replacement supplies its license. Corpus checks exercise local resource paths and fragments through the rebuilt engine.

Remove the unexposed visual-annotation path and marks-pane dependency. Bookfin bookmarks store reading locations, not SVG highlights. The marks-pane 1.0.9 package declares MIT but supplies no license text.
Replace raw ZIP/source hosting with one immutable passive Publication and ReaderResources admission boundary.

Narrow the Flutter bridge to an Android-only viewport. Deny native network loading, unlisted resources, navigations, permissions, windows, downloads, file access, content access, storage, and third-party cookies.
Retain the engine's no-script iframe sandbox. Serve trusted runtime scripts separately from passive publication documents with distinct content-security policies.

Port search corrections into engine/src/section.js and engine/src/passive-search.js. Match across all body text nodes, retain repeated and short-document matches, and map Unicode lowercase expansion back to original offsets.

Replace the broad upstream runtime interface with engine/src/reader.js for visible-start locations, quote validation, real fragment destinations, sequential cancellable search, and explicit incomplete results.

Apply the bundled serif as an inherited fallback, not an important body-font override, so explicit edition fonts survive reader appearance changes. Host CSS selection is tested separately from Android applied-font acceptance.
